title: Parameter - Body
description: The parameter is echoed within the main BODY tag. No server-side escaping is performed.
objectives: Inject HTML tags directly into the page body.
Execute JavaScript via a <script> tag injection.
Understand why unescaped output in the body context is dangerous.
hints: Your input appears directly inside <body>. Any HTML you type will be rendered.
You can also use event handlers: <img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
